mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, default_template_key, default_theme_uid, created_at, updated_at FROM user_vocabulary_preference WHERE user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_vocabulary_preference (user_id, default_template_key) VALUES (#{userId}, #{templateKey}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE default_template_key = VALUES(default_template_key), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

INSERT INTO user_vocabulary_preference (user_id, default_theme_uid) VALUES (#{userId}, #{themeUid}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE default_theme_uid = VALUES(default_theme_uid), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
